_comment: Values every AGL listing shares. Anything here can be overridden per app
in store/apps/<repo>.json. The URL templates take {slug}, which defaults
review_information.notes is deliberately absent: it describes one app to a reviewer, so it belongs in store/apps/<repo>.json, never here.

Policy pages are served by GitHub Pages (AmericanGroupLLC/AmericanGroupLLC.github.io). safecodeg.com cannot be deployed to from CI — see docs/MANUAL_ACTIONS.md MA-010 — and its /policy/* paths return the SPA homepage, which a reviewer would read as 'no privacy policy'.
